_help: One-shot lab benchmark. Edit the fields below and run: python scripts/06_run_single_test.py --config configs/single_test.json

_fields.engine: Path to a TensorRT .engine file (relative to package root or absolute).
_fields.capture_shape_hw: Synthetic RAW Bayer size as [H, W]. Optional; default is [1080, 1920]. With disable_resize=true and missing capture_shape_hw, it is auto-set to inference_shape_hw.
_fields.inference_shape_hw: Engine input size as [H, W]. Optional; if missing, auto-inferred from engine filename (e.g. 640, 960, 1088x1920, v640).
_fields.disable_resize: If true, test forbids resize and requires capture_shape_hw == inference_shape_hw.
_fields.batch: Engine batch size. Must match the .engine.
_fields.active_cameras: How many cameras carry real synthetic content. Must be 1..batch. Slots above active_cameras are filled with a dark blank frame, simulating fewer cameras connected.
_fields.target_fps: Desired sustained FPS per camera. 0 disables pacing (free-run, maximum throughput). 50 means: try to keep one packet every 20 ms.
_fields.bayer_pattern: RG / BG / GR / GB. Must match the synthetic source you want to mimic.
_fields.synthetic_source: Synthetic Bayer generator parameters. The same batch is generated once and reused in the loop, so the loop measures the GPU path only (not the CPU-side rendering cost).
